dedupe_keys.name: risk gis gis decision support tool for human health risk from industrial emissions

description: A GIS extension for mapping health risks from toxic releases at industrial and contaminated sites. The GECOsistema page says RISK-GIS is a GIS decision support system built as an extension of Esri ArcMap that maps fate and transport of toxic chemicals released continuously or accidentally and assesses exposure and risk, using models such as ASTM/RBCA Tier II, MODFLOW, MT3D, HSSM, Vleach, ISC3 and CALPUFF for transport and RBCA, HWIR and CALTOX for exposure and risk, for air, soil and groundwater. It is offered by the company as desktop software on request, not as a free download; the price and licence are not stated on the page read. Coverage is any site the user models. Caveats: it needs ArcMap and, as the page says, an experienced user. For simulation it estimates the health consequences of chemical releases from plants damaged by floods or earthquakes. A related catalogue record is the RAPID-N Natech risk tool.
